subject: COVID-19 Preparedness and France Trip Cancellation
overview: The Committee addressed the immediate impacts of the emerging COVID-19 pandemic by cancelling an international field trip and discussing school closure contingency plans. The body also approved wage increases for low-earning employees and authorized a new Playground Advisory Committee.

items.title: Routine Business
items.summary: Approved the minutes from February 24, 2020, along with bills, payroll, and fund transfers.

items.title: Middle School Health Curriculum
items.summary: Tabled the adoption of the Michigan model health curriculum for middle schools for two weeks to allow members more time to review the content binders.

items.title: School Committee Rules and Procedures
items.summary: Approved a new procedure for members to add items to the meeting agenda, amending the administrative response timeline to three school days.

items.title: Minimum Wage and Facility Tour Report
items.summary: Approved a pay increase for school employees earning ten dollars per hour to the state minimum wage, retroactive to January 1, 2020.

items.title: Dyslexia Protocols
items.summary: Referred a proposal from a resident regarding the creation of an ad hoc dyslexia committee and universal screening protocols to the Special Education subcommittee.

items.title: High School Vision Committee Diversity
items.summary: The Superintendent committed to adding diverse community members to the high school vision committee following public concern regarding a lack of representation during the initial selection.

items.title: Superintendent's Report and COVID-19 Update
items.summary: Recognized the retirement of Associate Superintendent Diane Caldwell and discussed pandemic preparations, including deep cleaning schedules and remote learning logistics.

items.title: Cancellation of April France Trip
items.summary: Approved the cancellation of the high school trip to France due to COVID-19 risks and authorized the Superintendent to negotiate with travel agencies for better refund terms.

items.title: School Choice and Field Trip Policies
items.summary: Voted not to participate in the state school choice program for the upcoming year and referred field trip insurance protocols to subcommittee for review.

items.title: Student Opportunity Act Plan
items.summary: Referred the Student Opportunity Act funding plan to subcommittee and voted to request a deadline extension from the state to allow for meaningful engagement with marginalized families.

items.title: Playground Advisory Committee Resolution
items.summary: Approved the creation of an advisory committee to oversee inclusive playground projects and design studies at several elementary schools.
